title: Secrets: references that travel, values that do not
note: Two failure modes, and they need different mutations. The first is accidental disclosure -- an f-string, a diagnostic dump, an exception message -- attacked by S1-S6, which remove the placeholder rendering and the redaction. The second is deliberate misuse, attacked by S7-S16, which remove the bindings that keep a credential tied to one actor, task, tool and purpose. S16 is the composition: holding a credential and holding egress are two grants, and using one on the other is a third thing neither implies.

mutations.name: S1_secret_renders_its_value
mutations.find:
def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"<secret:{self._secret_id}>"
mutations.rationale: every log line, exception and f-string that touches a Secret prints the credential

mutations.name: S2_format_bypasses_the_placeholder
mutations.find:
def __format__(self, spec: str) -> str:
        return str(self)
mutations.replace:
def __format__(self, spec: str) -> str:
        return format(self.reveal(), spec)
mutations.rationale: an f-string with a format spec goes through __format__ and leaks while __str__ still looks safe
